response.justification: Bogdan brings 20 years of solid software engineering experience and demonstrates strong technical leadership through staff-level roles, mentorship, and software craftsmanship advocacy. However, he fundamentally lacks the core qualification for this director-level AI Strategy role: recognized expertise in AI with demonstrated products or platforms built with AI. While his recent move into AI-agent infrastructure at re:cinq (April 2025) shows current exposure, this represents only ~4 months of focused AI work, far insufficient for a principal position requiring AI strategy expertise. The absence of an advanced degree in AI/ML and any evidence of strategic advisory experience compounds this gap.
strengths: 20 years of progressive software engineering experience across diverse domains (web, mobile, embedded, infrastructure) with multiple staff-level roles demonstrating sustained technical leadership
Strong advocate for software craftsmanship and knowledge sharing through workshops, conference talks, and mentorship; organized teams around best practices like TDD, CI/CD, and code quality
Full-stack technical versatility with demonstrated fluency across multiple languages and platforms including TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, AWS CDK, Docker, and Kubernetes
concerns: No demonstrated AI/ML expertise or proven track record building AI products or platforms; AI exposure is recent (April 2025) representing only ~4 months of focused experience
Missing advanced degree in AI, machine learning, or related field; lacks the academic foundation typically expected for principal-level AI strategy roles
No evidence of strategic advisory experience with customers or partners on technology adoption; role has been primarily implementation-focused rather than strategic leadership-oriented

key_factors.factor: Strong foundational engineering and leadership background
Lack of strategic advisory and thought leadership experience
